strategy.summary: Kettle & Co. has no smoke tests. Add a small Playwright smoke suite (tests/smoke/shop.spec.js) of read-only checks of the critical paths: the app answers its health check, the catalogue lists what the shop sells, a product page shows its product, adding to the cookie cart shows it in the cart, and checkout opens with the order form. Each test is tagged @smoke, reaches the app only via the configured baseURL (BASE_URL or the locally started shop), and never submits an order.
inScope: Product page /products/:id reached from the catalogue
Add to cart (browser cookie only) and the cart page
Checkout page with the order form (not submitted)
A test:smoke npm script that runs only @smoke tests
outOfScope: Placing an order (POST /orders) — it writes data on the server; left to the full e2e suite (tests/checkout.spec.js)
Order confirmation page — only reachable after placing an order
Error paths (404, 405, empty-cart checkout) — not smoke
Automated accessibility (axe) checks — no axe dependency in the repo; smoke suite kept minimal
assumptions: The product list is code (src/catalogue.js PRODUCTS), not seeded data, so every deployed build of this commit shows it; tests import PRODUCTS/formatPrice rather than copying names and prices.
Adding to cart only writes the browser's cart cookie (public/app.js); no request reaches the server, so it is read-only for the deployment.
No faking: the real shop runs (started by playwright.config.js webServer locally, or the deployed build via BASE_URL). The app has no login, so no credentials are used.
This run does not execute the tests (target not disposable); the PR's CI (npx playwright test) runs them against the locally started shop.
openQuestions: Should CI or the deploy pipeline run `npm run test:smoke` with BASE_URL against staging before production? That is a pipeline change outside this PR.

risks.description: A deployed build whose catalogue differs from the tests' checkout would fail product-name assertions
risks.mitigation: Names and prices are imported from src/catalogue.js of the same commit that is deployed.

risks.description: A smoke test accidentally writes data in production
risks.mitigation: No test submits the checkout form or makes a non-GET request; cart is cookie-only.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The app is up: GET /health answers 200 with {status: 'ok'}
The catalogue page shows the shop's heading and a link to every product with its price
A user can open a product page from the catalogue and see its name, price and Add to cart button
A user can add a product to the cart and the cart page shows it with the right total
A user with items in the cart can reach checkout and see the order form
Every smoke test is tagged @smoke, only reads, and reaches the app through the configured base URL; `npm run test:smoke` runs them
acceptanceCriteria.metBy: tests/smoke/shop.spec.js uses only relative URLs with Playwright's baseURL, makes no POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, each title ends with @smoke; package.json gets "test:smoke": "playwright test --grep @smoke".

testCases.title: health check reports the shop is up @smoke
testCases.rationale: Critical path: the build starts and answers; the cheapest go/no-go signal.

testCases.title: catalogue lists every product with its price @smoke
steps: For each product in PRODUCTS, check its link and its price
testCases.expected: Heading visible, one link per product named exactly, each list item shows the formatted price
testCases.rationale: Critical path: the home page renders what the shop sells.

testCases.title: opens a product page from the catalogue @smoke
testCases.expected: URL /products/teapot, heading 'Cast-iron teapot', price £48.00, 'Add to cart' button visible
testCases.rationale: Critical path: a user reaches a product.

testCases.title: adds a product to the cart and shows it in the cart @smoke
steps: Check status 'Added to your cart' and link 'Cart (1)'
testCases.expected: Cart page heading 'Your cart', a cell 'Cast-iron teapot', quantity 1, 'Total: £48.00'
testCases.rationale: Critical path: the cart works (cookie only, no server write).

testCases.title: opens checkout with the order form for a filled cart @smoke
testCases.expected: Heading 'Checkout', Name/Email/Address fields and an enabled 'Place order' button visible; the form is not submitted
testCases.rationale: Critical path: the checkout page that takes money renders, without placing an order.

strategy.environmentNotes: BASE_URL selects a deployed build; without it playwright.config.js starts `node src/server.js` on port 4175. Browsers: `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium` (already in CI).

refusals.reason: tests/smoke/shop.spec.js written before testforge:api, testforge:playwright, testforge:implementation were loaded
`playwright` runs tests, and this run writes a smoke suite for http://host.docker.internal:62614, which isn't marked disposable, without running it.
